title: Dutch Baby Pancake
description: A single pancake that climbs the sides of a hot skillet in the oven and collapses the moment it comes out. Five minutes of work, and the batter does the rest.
notes: Room-temperature eggs and milk are the difference between a dramatic rise and a flat disc.

steps.text: Put a cast iron skillet in the oven and heat it thoroughly.
steps.tip: The pan must be properly hot before the batter hits it. This is the whole trick.

steps.text: Blend the eggs, milk, flour, sugar, and salt until completely smooth and slightly frothy.
Let the batter stand while the pan finishes heating.
Drop the butter into the hot skillet, swirl it up the sides as it melts, then pour the batter straight in.
Bake without opening the door until puffed and deeply browned at the edges.
Serve straight from the pan with a squeeze of lemon and a dusting of powdered sugar.
